subject.title: fix(workspace): prevent false Missing labels on existing files and fix panel layout overlap

question: Should `sessions.files.list` ever expose existence, size, or mtime for transcript-mentioned paths outside or rejected by the workspace fs-safe boundary?
rationale: The current PR can only be accepted as written if maintainers intentionally expand the session-file metadata boundary; otherwise the raw stat fallback should be removed or replaced with boundary-preserving semantics.

options.title: Keep Fs-Safe Boundary
options.body: Reject raw external metadata and require a fix that filters or neutrally labels outside-root entries without statting arbitrary paths.

options.title: Allow External Metadata
options.body: Accept transcript-mentioned external file metadata only with explicit security approval and focused protocol/UI tests for the new contract.

options.title: Split Layout From Backend
options.body: Preserve any still-needed rail layout CSS separately and resolve external Missing semantics through the linked issue or a narrower backend PR.

recommendation.title: Keep Fs-Safe Boundary
recommendation.body: Reject raw external metadata and require a fix that filters or neutrally labels outside-root entries without statting arbitrary paths.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the session workspace rail and its original safe preview boundary, making them the best history-based reviewer for the intended contract.
